text: Budget 2024 allocated nearly $1 billion for recovery and resilience projects in regions affected by the 2023 weather events. An additional NZ$219 million was allocated in Budget 2025 for local road recovery in five North Island councils. The Crown Resilience Programme (CRP) set aside NZ$419 million over seven years for proactive resilience measures, with NZ$279 million for state highways and NZ$140 million for local roads.
